answer: Each new agent wallet must publish a rotating beacon of verifiable work anchored to an existing reputed identity through a stake that is slashed if duplication is proven. To reach payout, an operator has to fund every persona separately and keep each one distinct at the summit of the trust graph, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand real deposits plus ongoing liveness fees. Since the entry stake is never refunded once a clone is caught, a meadow full of copies becomes pure loss rather than cheap amplification.
